name: activity-dashboard
description: Live pane showing what Claude is doing: tools, files, edits, browser clicks and subagent windows

autoOpen.title: Open automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the Activity pane by itself when a session starts.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Animate the preview, spinners and browser cursor. Off draws everything still.

historySize.title: Sessions kept
historySize.description: How many past sessions the HTML report keeps (1-50).

reportFolder.title: Report folder
reportFolder.description: Where HTML reports are saved. Empty means ~/.claude/activity-reports.
